facts.quote: 감출 수 없는 세월이 서린 노인의 주름진 얼굴

facts.fact: Bald head that shines in sunlight

facts.quote: 비록 몸은 젊어졌으나 눈빛에 담긴 세월만은 여전하다.

facts.fact: Hair growing back in recently, like spring sprouts (previously bald/shaven)

ranges.description: Jeok Cheongang is a small, slight elderly man with a wrinkled, aged face, a fierce and ill-tempered look that turns demon-like when he frowns, and clear, transparent eyes. He has a bald head that shines in sunlight, red eyebrows and a dark red beard, and wears ragged clothing. Tags: elderly man, small slight frame, wrinkled face, fierce scowl, clear eyes, bald head, red eyebrows, dark red beard, ragged clothes

Jeok Cheongang is a small, slight man with a youthful body, clear, transparent eyes and a steady, weighty gaze. His face is fierce and ill-tempered, looking like a wrathful demon when he frowns. He has red eyebrows and a dark red beard. His once-bald head now shows short new hair sprouting like spring shoots. Tags: youthful body, small slight frame, clear eyes, fierce face, red eyebrows, dark red beard, short sprouting hair, ragged clothes
